source.title: Pobačaj je "Sakrament" Sotone - Marija Šošić [PODCAST Mreže Riječi #29]

summary.title_hr: Pobačaj je "Sakrament" Sotone - Marija Šošić [PODCAST Mreže Riječi #29]
summary.abstract_hr: U emisiji Mreže Riječi voditelj razgovara s Marijom Šošić, voditeljicom Centra za život u Splitu, o zaštiti nerođenog života, pomoći trudnicama u teškim okolnostima i podršci ženama i muškarcima ranjenima pobačajem. Gošća opisuje kako je Centar proizašao iz inicijative "40 dana za život" i kroz krovnu udrugu "Hrvatska za život" nudi savjetovanje, materijalnu pomoć, radionice, grupe podrške i duhovno-psihološki program "Oprostom oslobođene". Razgovara se o duhovnoj pozadini pobačaja, ulozi očeva i obitelji, stigmatizaciji brojnih obitelji, odgovornosti države i društva te o pitanjima pobačaja nakon silovanja i kod bolesti djeteta. Gošća iznosi svjedočanstvo mlade sezonske radnice koja je odustala od pobačaja i danas je sretna majka. Emisija završava porukom da je kriza privremena, a pobačaj zauvijek, te pozivom na molitvu, volontiranje i donacije.
key_points: Centar za život u Splitu djeluje šest godina. Proizašao je iz inicijative "40 dana za život", koja traje 12 godina, a kroz krovnu udrugu "Hrvatska za život" trudnicama pruža individualnu pomoć, povezuje ih sa stručnjacima te organizira radionice (npr. izradu krunica) i grupe podrške.

Centru se javljaju i majke i očevi ranjeni pobačajem, često i desetljećima nakon njega. Za njih je pokrenut duhovno-psihološki program "Oprostom oslobođene", nakon kojega se mnoge žene uključe u molitvu pred bolnicom.

Gošća pobačaj smatra duhovnom stvarnošću na koju se odgovara prije svega molitvom i postom. Navodi da žene koje su pobacile najčešće idu na zahvat sa suzama, dok majke koje su odabrale život svjedoče o radosti.
Prema gošći, najveći broj pobačaja događa se u obiteljima, kod žena koje su već majke, a jedno je vrijeme najčešće bilo riječ o trećem djetetu. Obitelji s više djece danas su, kaže, stigmatizirane.
O pobačaju nakon silovanja gošća kaže da on neće izliječiti ženinu ranu, nego će stvoriti novu. Kao primjer navodi najbolju prijateljicu začetu silovanjem, koja je danas majka sedmero djece.
Očev potpis za pobačaj nije potreban, pa se Centru javljaju očevi kojima je, kako kažu, oduzeto očinstvo. Gošća ističe da je izostanak muške podrške i zaštite čest razlog zbog kojega žena pobaci.

Inicijativa zna za 200 spašenih dječjih života, a Centar trenutno skrbi za više od 50 trudnica. Gošća poručuje da je kriza privremena, a pobačaj zauvijek, te da je Centar dostupan 24 sata dnevno putem Facebooka i Instagrama.
mentioned_organizations: Majke u zagrljaju majke (Mame za mame)
key_topics_en: help for pregnant women and mothers
key_points_en: The Centar za život in Split has been active for six years. It emerged from the initiative "40 dana za život", which has lasted for 12 years, and through the umbrella association "Hrvatska za život" provides pregnant women with individual help, connects them with experts, and organizes workshops (e.g., Rosary making) and support groups.

Both mothers and fathers wounded by abortion turn to the Center, often even decades after it. For them, the spiritual-psychological program "Oprostom oslobođene" was launched, after which many women join the prayer in front of the hospital.

The guest considers abortion a spiritual reality that is responded to above all with prayer and fasting. She states that women who have had an abortion most often go to the procedure with tears, while mothers who chose life testify to joy.

According to the guest, the largest number of abortions happens in families, among women who are already mothers, and for a time it was most often the third child. Families with more children are today, she says, stigmatized.

Regarding abortion after rape, the guest says that it will not heal a woman's wound, but will create a new one. As an example, she mentions a best friend conceived through rape, who is today a mother of seven children.

A father's signature is not required for an abortion, so fathers turn to the Center whose fatherhood, as they say, was taken away. The guest points out that the absence of male support and protection is a frequent reason why a woman has an abortion.

The initiative knows of 200 saved children's lives, and the Center currently cares for more than 50 pregnant women. The guest conveys that a crisis is temporary, but abortion is forever, and that the Center is available 24 hours a day via Facebook and Instagram.

summary.title_en: Abortion Is the "Sacrament" of Satan - Marija Šošić [PODCAST Mreže Riječi #29]
summary.abstract_en: In the Mreže Riječi show, the host talks with Marija Šošić, head of the Centar za život in Split, about the protection of unborn life, helping pregnant women in difficult circumstances, and supporting women and men wounded by abortion. The guest describes how the Center emerged from the initiative "40 dana za život" and, through the umbrella association "Hrvatska za život", offers counseling, material aid, workshops, support groups, and the spiritual-psychological program "Oprostom oslobođene". They discuss the spiritual background of abortion, the role of fathers and families, the stigmatization of large families, the responsibility of the state and society, and questions of abortion after rape and in cases of child illness. The guest shares the testimony of a young seasonal worker who gave up on abortion and is today a happy mother. The show concludes with the message that a crisis is temporary, but abortion is forever, and an invitation to prayer, volunteering, and donations.
